text: Supports building a custom POS integration via API plus official SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native
quote: Build a custom POS integration tailored to your business. Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.

text: Lets customers pay contactlessly using Tap to Pay on a compatible iPhone, no extra reader hardware needed
quote: Use Tap to Pay on iPhone to accept in-person contactless payments with a compatible iPhone.

text: Can be added to existing POS, hardware, and commerce stacks without writing any code
quote: You can incorporate Stripe Terminal into your existing stack using third-party POS, hardware, and commerce integrations—no code required.

text: Groups readers into locations and zones to manage devices across multiple physical sites
quote: You can streamline the management of multiple readers across different physical sites by using locations and zones.

text: Readers can be registered by serial number before someone physically has the device in hand
quote: You can register readers using their serial number. This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it, so you can use it immediately after you unbox it.

text: Stores payments locally on the device when offline and auto-forwards them once connectivity returns
quote: If you have internet connectivity issues, Stripe Terminal allows you to store payments locally on your POS device or smart reader. When a network connection is restored, the SDK or smart reader automatically forwards any stored payments to

text: Reader can prompt customers with suggested tip amounts before payment is collected
quote: On-reader tipping: The card reader suggests tips to customers before collecting payment.

text: Supports prebuilt email receipts or fully custom on-brand receipts built from API receipt data
quote: You can use Stripe’s prebuilt email receipts, or use receipt data from the Stripe API and your Terminal integration to generate on-brand custom receipts.

text: Ships with a built-in simulated card reader so apps can be developed and tested without physical hardware
quote: Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.

text: Manages in-person and online payments together in one unified Dashboard view
quote: You can manage both in-person payments and online payments in a unified system in the Dashboard.

text: Integrates Terminal with a Connect platform to support connected accounts
quote: Use Terminal with Connect to support connected accounts.

text: Offers the Terminal JavaScript SDK as an ES module
quote: Use the Terminal JS SDK as an ES module.

text: Lets merchants collect tips either before or after authorizing a payment
quote: Use Terminal to collect tips from your customer before or after authorizing a payment.

text: Registers smart readers via a registration code, serial number, or order number
quote: You can register smart readers in one of three ways: - Registration code - Serial number - Order number

text: Accepts contactless payments on a compatible iPhone or Android device via the Terminal SDK
quote: Accept contactless payments using a compatible iPhone or Android device with the Stripe Terminal SDK.

text: Provides a no-code option to accept in-person payments on a compatible reader without building a custom POS integration
quote: Use no-code options: Accept payments without building a custom POS integration.

text: Lets you refund a payment directly from the Dashboard's Payments page
quote: To refund a payment using the Dashboard: 1. Find the payment you want to refund in the Payments page. 2. Click the overflow menu (⋯) ... then select Refund payment.

text: Supports issuing refunds through either the Refunds API or the Dashboard
quote: You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard.

text: Lets you deploy a custom Android POS app directly onto Stripe smart readers
quote: Deploy your Android POS app to Stripe smart readers.

text: Lets you order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard
quote: Reader management: Order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard.

text: Provides an MCP server so AI agents can call the Stripe API and search Stripe's docs and support content
quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe’s knowledge base, including documentation and support articles.

text: Offers agent-first developer tools and lets agents transact on a merchant's behalf via agentic commerce
quote: Agents and AI on Stripe: Build with agent-first developer tools, and sell agent-enabled products and services. Build your integration with agent-first developer tools, charge your users for AI features with usage-based billing, and let agen

text: Provides the Stripe CLI to build, test, and manage a Stripe integration from the terminal
quote: The Stripe CLI helps you build, test, and manage your Stripe integration right from the terminal.

text: Pushes real-time events to a registered HTTPS webhook endpoint so integrations can react automatically
quote: Listen for events from Stripe on your webhook endpoint so your integration can automatically trigger reactions. You can create an HTTPS webhook endpoint to receive events. After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data

text: Instant Payouts send available balance to your bank account anytime, usually arriving within 30 minutes
quote: Stripe sends funds from your available balance to your bank account as payouts. With Instant Payouts you can send payouts any time, including weekends and holidays, and funds usually appear in the associated bank account within 30 minutes.

text: Smart Disputes automates evidence collection and submission for eligible chargebacks
quote: To help you submit the best possible response for each dispute, Stripe guides you through the process in the Dashboard. Use Smart Disputes to automate evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes.

text: Publishes an OpenAPI specification covering Stripe's API
quote: Stripe's OpenAPI Specification: This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.

text: A generated pairing code can be entered into the Dashboard or API to register a reader
quote: After generating the pairing code, you can enter it in the Dashboard or API to register the reader.

text: Automatically emails a compliant receipt when a receipt_email is supplied and the PaymentIntent is captured
quote: When you provide a receipt_email, Stripe automatically emails a compliant receipt to the customer when capturing the PaymentIntent.

text: Requires merchants to offer customers a physical or email receipt option for in-person payments
quote: If you accept payments using Stripe Terminal, you must provide customers with the option to receive a physical or email receipt.
